newsitem.title: UK: NWE spot gasoline prices ease, paper holds ground.
newsitem.headline: NWE spot gasoline prices ease, paper holds ground.

text.p: NWE spot gasoline prices were easier in late trade on Monday led lower by weaker crude and NYMEX unleaded futures in thin trade, traders said.
Some support for the prompt market was seen coming from tightening Mediterranean supply where good demand to take product to West Africa recently has drawn heavily on supplies.
Eurograde barges were valued around $2 lower at $200 for refinery Rotterdam material fob, while cargoes slipped $1 per tonne to $203/$207 cif NWE.
Forward paper contracts were also more stable, cushioned by the anticipated seasonal pick-up in demand.
The March Eurograde/Naphtha spread traded actively around $10.50 a tonne and April Eurograde swaps traded $201 up to $203.
